coordinates.note: Institute-level point (1.5 km precision), the OSM node of the JINR office in the centre of Dubna; the accelerator complex of the Veksler and Baldin Laboratory of High Energy Physics is about 2.5 km north-east of it (see site:jinr-vblhep-accelerator-complex).
coordinates.quote: Территориально ОИЯИ расположен в городе Дубне

name: JINR, Dubna (Joint Institute for Nuclear Research)

summary.plain: The central site of the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia, an international research organisation founded in 1956 whose laboratories include one for high-energy physics with the Nuclotron and NICA accelerators.
summary.technical: JINR, Dubna: institute-level point (OSM node of the JINR office); laboratories are spread over the town, the high-energy accelerators being at the VBLHEP site to the north-east.
